name: Attribute Mismatch
description: Wrong attribute selection. The selected attribute does not match the required attribute for the query.

name: Attribute Redundancy
description: Unnecessary attributes included in the SELECT clause or other parts of the query.

name: Attribute Missing
description: Required attributes not included in the query, missing columns that should be selected or used.

name: Table Mismatch
description: Wrong table selection. The query uses an incorrect table for retrieving data.

name: Table Redundancy
description: Unnecessary tables included in the FROM clause or JOINs.

name: Table Missing
description: Required tables not included in the query, missing tables that should be joined.

name: Join Condition Mismatch
description: The join condition between tables is incorrect. If the [attribute][operator][attribute] is incorrectly chosen, the error is classified here rather than as 'Attribute Mismatch'.

name: Join Type Mismatch
description: Wrong join type used, e.g., LEFT JOIN when INNER JOIN was needed, or vice versa.

name: Value Mismatch
description: Incorrect values used in WHERE conditions or other parts of the query.

name: Data Format Mismatch
description: Wrong data type or format used, e.g., string instead of number, or incorrect date format.

name: Comparison Operator Mismatch
description: Wrong comparison operator used in conditions, e.g., '=' when '!=' was needed, or '>' instead of '<'.

name: Logical Operator Mismatch
description: Wrong logical operator (e.g., AND when OR needed) or incorrect operator precedence causing logic errors.

name: Explicit Condition Missing
description: Required conditions not included in the WHERE clause or other filtering clauses.

name: Explicit Condition Mismatch
description: Wrong conditions where two of [attribute], [operator], [value] are incorrect. If only one is wrong, it should be classified as attribute, value, or operator error.

name: Explicit Condition Redundancy
description: Unnecessary conditions included that do not contribute to the correct result.

name: Implicit Condition Missing
description: Missing implicit conditions such as IS NOT NULL or other assumptions about data.

name: Aggregate Functions
description: Incorrect use of aggregate functions like SUM, AVG, COUNT, MAX, MIN.

name: Window Functions
description: Incorrect use of window functions like OVER, PARTITION BY, ROW_NUMBER, RANK.

name: Date/Time Functions
description: Incorrect use of date/time functions like JULIANDAY, strftime, DATE, DATETIME.

name: Conversion Functions
description: Incorrect use of type conversion functions like CAST, CONVERT.

name: Math Functions
description: Incorrect use of mathematical functions like ROUND, ABS, CEIL, FLOOR.

name: String Functions
description: Incorrect use of string functions like SUBSTR, LENGTH, UPPER, LOWER, TRIM.

name: Conditional Functions
description: Incorrect use of conditional functions like IIF, CASE WHEN, COALESCE, NULLIF.

name: Clause Missing
description: Required clauses not included, such as GROUP BY, ORDER BY, HAVING, LIMIT.

name: Clause Redundancy
description: Unnecessary clauses included, such as unneeded GROUP BY, ORDER BY, or HAVING.

name: Subquery Missing
description: Required subquery not included where a nested query was needed.

name: Subquery Mismatch
description: Incorrect subquery logic, wrong subquery structure or conditions.

name: Partial Query
description: The error SQL query is a partial query that contributes to the correct SQL query, incomplete implementation.

name: ASC/DESC
description: Incorrect sorting order specified, ASC instead of DESC or vice versa.

name: DISTINCT
description: Incorrect use of DISTINCT keyword - either missing when needed or present when unnecessary.

name: Other
description: Major logical errors requiring complete rewrite, or errors that do not fit into the above categories.
